processDescription: 5-axis CNC milling centers provide simultaneous multi-axis interpolation for complex titanium components. The ability to tilt the tool relative to the workpiece surface maintains optimal chip load and extends tool life, critical for difficult-to-machine titanium alloys, specifically for nozzle. Precision nozzle for Aerospace, Chemical present unique challenges: Small internal orifices (Ø1–6 mm) with tight position tolerances (±0.05 mm) require gun drilling or EDM. Internal surface finish critical for flow characteristics.
heatControl: High-pressure coolant-through-spindle (50–70 bar) with coated carbide tooling. Adaptive trochoidal milling paths reduce radial engagement to control heat generation.
flatnessControl: Stress-relieved raw material and sequenced roughing/finishing passes. Heat-sink fixturing for thin-wall sections minimizes thermal distortion.
capabilitiesDescription: Precision machining capability for CNC machining of venturi nozzle profiles, utilizing multi-axis CNC centers with in-process inspection and SPC quality control.
